project.name: osgi/manifests
project.description: The manifests domain — the rke2lab view on cdk8s: it owns the cdk8s synthesis runtime (manifests-cdk8s, the carrier that embeds the flat cdk8s closure and exports it to the OSGi world) and the model/synthesis logic that puts cdk8s back into the rke2lab context (manifests-core), over the contract both worlds share (manifests-port). Other domains contribute their own cdk8s rendering as fragments of the carrier (e.g. systemd-cdk8s-manifests).
